svg.text: py-spy record -o /h/flames-stock/TP10_values.svg --rate 50 --nonblocking -- python3 -c from openpyxl import load_workbook wb = load_workbook('output/monthly_operations_report.xlsx', data_only=True) ws = wb['Executive_Summary'] if 'Executive_Summary' in wb.sheetnames else wb['Reconciliation'] for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=5): print([c.value for c in row]) wb.close()
